paragraphs.text: Chapter 2 The Handsome Prince
A hundred years passed. There was a new king of the land. He had a son who always went hunting.
One day, the prince saw the castle towers in the forest. The prince went into the thick forest.
As he came near the castle, the vines and trees magically separated.
He could pass through the forest. Everything was silent in the courtyard. People were sleeping everywhere.
Finally, the prince came to a golden room. There on a high bed was the most beautiful lady he had ever seen.
The prince touched her hand. And the lovely princess woke. She looked at the prince as if she had always known him.
Is that you, my prince? She whispered. I've waited a long time for you. The princess heart jumped for joy.
I have fallen in love with you.
answered the prince. He asked the princess to marry him and she agreed.
After two years, the prince and princess had two children. The eldest was a girl named Don.
The second was a boy and they called him day. After day's birth, the old king passed away.
The prince then became king. The new king had to go fight in a war.
Please rule in my place. He asked his mother. She was originally an ogres. She had a bad temper.
After he left, his mother ordered the king's wife and children to live in a country house.
The king's mother called the cook and said, I want to eat little Don for dinner tomorrow.
The poor man knew that he could not argue with an ogres. So he got his knife and went to Don's room.
However, the man could not hurt the smiling child. Instead, he chose a young lamb from the barn.
He prepared it for dinner the next day. The ogres queen greedily ate up all the lamb.
She's even tastier than I'd imagined. She said.
The next Sunday, the king's mother said to the cook, I want to eat little day for lunch.
The cook hid day in a barn with Don. Then he prepared a tender young goat for lunch.
He is delicious. You prepared a fine meal. Said the ogres. Now I shall eat the queen.
So the cook hid the queen in the barn with the children and then cooked a young deer.
The ogres ate all of it. She was very pleased. She planned on lying to her son.
She would tell him that wolves had eaten his family. One day, the ogres went walking.
She walked past the barn and her children laughing. She heard a mother's voice hushing them.
It was the young queen with her children. The ogres was angry because she had been tricked.
Get the biggest pot in the kingdom. Put it in the courtyard.
Fill it with snakes, toads and some spiders. She said, I'll throw the queen, the children and the cook in it to die.
And I love watching. The next day, the ogres' servants prepared everything.
They were ready to throw the young queen into the pot. Suddenly, the king rode through the gate.
What on earth is going on here? He demanded no one dared to speak. The ogres was furious.
She knew that she couldn't always have her own way. So she jumped into the pot.
The snakes and spiders instantly ate her. The king was upset for a while. However, his sadness gradually disappeared.
He was happy to be with his beautiful wife and his two pretty children.
